paragraphs: Lightspeed Systems sells a connected platform of K-12 edtech products that give schools visibility and control across safety, security, compliance, device management, and analytics. Its filter covers every digital interaction on and off the network, protecting students from cyber risks and distractions while keeping access and compliance in place.

Filtering is enforced on the device itself, with an on-device SmartAgent and SmartShield DNS filtering covering school-managed, BYOD, and IoT devices. Lightspeed Alert monitors online activity, flags concerning behaviors, and enables intervention before a tragedy occurs. Those alerts are backed by round-the-clock monitoring from the company's own safety specialists. Lightspeed Classroom gives teachers visibility into and control over student activity to minimize distractions and maximize instructional time. Lightspeed StopIt is an anonymous reporting system for safety, misconduct, or compliance concerns. An analytics product shows granular app and device usage down to the grade and student level.

The company states that 28 of the 50 largest US school districts use its software, naming Los Angeles Unified, Houston ISD, Miami-Dade County Public Schools, and Fairfax County Public Schools. It puts the wider count at 31,000 schools around the world. The filter is described as designed for CIPA, FERPA, and NIST-aligned environments, with exportable audit trails and long-term retention.

quote.text: Lightspeed Systems provides a connected platform of K-12 edtech solutions that deliver visibility and control to help schools minimize risk and maximize outcomes across safety, security, compliance, device management, and analytics.
